title: 英伟达/谷歌/英特尔接连出手，物理AI打响基础设施之争
content: In October 2026, NVIDIA, Google, and Intel advanced Physical AI infrastructure by bridging digital and physical worlds. Google introduced Genie 4, a world model for realistic, interactive simulations. NVIDIA expanded its Isaac platform, integrating data, simulation, and deployment tools for robot development. Simultaneously, Intel and SAP demonstrated an autonomous warehouse prototype, linking enterprise systems with robotic execution. These initiatives shift focus from pure model intelligence to building comprehensive technical ecosystems that enable AI to understand physical environments and execute real-world tasks.

content: Credit rating agencies are warning that artificial intelligence investments are straining tech companies' financial stability. title: 存算一体与感存算融合：类脑视觉的技术突破
content: Iron-electric optoelectronic sensor arrays achieve integrated sensing, storage, and computing (ISC) to overcome the Von Neumann "storage wall" in machine vision. By storing synaptic weights in ferroelectric polarization states, these arrays perform analog multiply-accumulate operations locally. This bio-inspired approach mimics retinal processing, significantly reducing data movement, latency, and energy consumption. While promising for edge AI applications, industrialization requires addressing device variability, array parasitics, and algorithm-hardware co-design challenges.

title: OpenAI 等四家企业将推行 AI 数据抓取退出统一标准
content: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic will implement a unified standard for opting out of AI data crawling. This standard allows content publishers to use a single robots.txt directive to instruct all participating AI companies not to scrape their sites for model training, eliminating the need for separate agreements. Anthropic has already adopted the standard, while OpenAI, Google, and Microsoft plan to support it within the coming months. Meta also supports establishing such a general signal but has not yet specified implementation details.
